method.description: Six silent headless Chromium screenshots were inspected: three exact unpacked EPUB pages and three bounded XHTML slices copied from exact content.xhtml sibling subtrees with the package CSS and SVG resources.

about.finding: Bengali shaping is clear; the 18-of-722 and 704-untranslated scope notice is prominent; headings, identifiers, links, and license lead-in render without clipping or overlap.

navigation.finding: The hierarchical Bengali table of contents renders legibly with chapter and section nesting; the landmarks heading follows it in reading order.

content_opening.finding: The book title, embedded contents, and opening text use the packaged Bengali font with stable margins and no overlap.

set_math_diagram.finding: Bengali prose, inline and display MathML, the union SVG, caption, and bordered definition render together without clipping, overlap, or horizontal crop.

relation_graph.finding: Graph definitions, formulas, both complete SVG graph examples, captions, and the following exercise render in order without clipping or overlap.

relation_order_narrow.finding: At a narrow reading width, Bengali paragraphs and inline MathML reflow, bordered definition blocks retain structure, and no horizontal clipping or overlap is visible.

limitations: This is a bounded representative visual review in Chromium. It is not a claim of exhaustive reading-system interoperability, assistive-technology testing, human accessibility certification, or review of untranslated scope.
